The only way Fiedler could get back to earth alive was to fly the pulse jet missile and land it on the airstrip. This had never been done before. Now a quiet-spoken, middle-aged man, Fiedler is an aeronautical engineer for Lockheed's Missiles and Space Division at Sunnyvale, where he played a key role in the development of the Navy's Polaris missile.
